function.name: xtra_search_products
function.description: Search the Colruyt catalogue for real products by name. Use this before adding groceries so the list gets the exact article — the Xtra app then shows a photo of what to look for in-store. Returns product_id, brand, content, price and an image per match. When several matches are plausible, ask the user which one they mean instead of guessing.

term.description: What to search for, translated to Dutch — the Colruyt catalogue only matches Dutch product names ('peanut butter' -> 'pindakaas')

function.name: xtra_list_items
function.description: Read the Colruyt Xtra shopping list — the real grocery list shared with the household and visible in the Xtra app in-store. Returns each item's id (needed to remove it), description and whether it is already ticked off.

include_completed.description: Also return items already ticked off (default false)

function.name: xtra_add_items
function.description: Add one or more groceries to the Colruyt Xtra shopping list. The list holds catalogue products only, so every entry needs a product_id: call xtra_search_products first and add the match. The description is only used to report back what was added — the stored line carries the product's own name. If a product is already on the list but ticked off, this reactivates that existing item (returned under 'reactivated') instead of adding a duplicate.

description.description: What to buy; keep Colruyt's own product names as they are when they come from a search

product_id.description: Colruyt technical article number, from xtra_search_products

function.name: xtra_remove_item
function.description: Remove an item from the Colruyt Xtra shopping list by its id. Call xtra_list_items first to get the id.
